translations.web: The servant ran to meet her, and said, “Please give me a drink, a little water from your pitcher.”
translations.bsb: So the servant ran to meet her and said, “Please let me have a little water from your jar.”
translations.kjv: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher.
